implementation.identity: Existing canonical_id, source.path, source.locator, title and summary remain exact, including empty materialized defaults.
implementation.metadata: Complete six-field Entity envelope, full five-field SourceReference and open nested properties; Python value types and absence/null/empty distinctions preserved.
implementation.exclusion_scope: Only those exact top-level properties keys. Unknown _native_ names and nested names remain.
implementation.validation: Requires an Entity of kind Test and revalidates its materialized strict contract, including source-path and SHA guards.
implementation.provenance: No filesystem access, discovery, reclassification, hashing, existence refresh or inferred component membership.
implementation.derived: Empty. No generated test outcomes, function inventory, durations, execution timestamps or coverage assertions.
implementation.ownership: Returned metadata is an independent deep copy; input Entity and nested values remain unmodified. Relationship anchors remain outside this adapter.

red.reason: Reader module did not exist before implementation.

mutations.method: Each defect injected into the actually imported reader in a separate Python process; repository implementation unchanged. Per-test XML and output receipts retained.

verification.lint: ruff format and ruff check passed for reader and tests.

count_basis: No repository test enumeration. Exactly the existing immutable Test entities supplied by the caller are enriched.
integration_scope: Root agent wires the adapter into native_metadata dispatch and verifies immutable snapshot publication and physical Neo4j fields. This coder made no shared-code, database, Aura or user-checkout changes.
limitations: The reader intentionally does not assert test execution or source-file freshness; those facts cannot be derived from a reference node.
